senses.gloss:
कैकय कैकय, अस्, m. the king of the
Kekayas; (आस्), m. pl. the sons of this king; (ई), f.
a daughter of this king.

कैकेय, अस्, m. a descendant of Kekaya, who was
prince of the Kekayas; a son of Śivi; Dṛṣṭaketu,
king of the Kekayas and father of the five Kaikeyas;
(आस्), m. pl. the Kekayas; (ई), f. a daughter of the
prince of the Kekayas, one of the wives of Daśa-
ratha, mother of Bharata; a shrew, a scold.
